companyFocus.name: Dreame
companyFocus.role: Consumer cleaning and floor-care robot manufacturer
companyFocus.reviewNotes: Batch164. Dreame pages read as text only; no research browser, visual inspection, OCR or media reuse. X50 Ultra, L40 Ultra, Matrix10 Ultra and Aqua10 Ultra Roller are four separate current models. No login, forms, contact, messages or transactions. All USPs, complete portfolios and leadership remain unproven.
highlights: Dreame is a consumer cleaning and floor-care robot manufacturer whose current US range includes the X50 Ultra, L40 Ultra, Matrix10 Ultra and Aqua10 Ultra Roller.

Its robot vacuum lines use different mop systems: multi-mop switching on the Matrix10 Ultra, a self-rinsing roller mop on the Aqua10 Ultra Roller, MopExtend RoboSwing on the L40 Ultra and a retractable VersaLift sensor on the X50 Ultra.
The reviewed pages publish 11,000 Pa suction for the L40 Ultra, 20,000 Pa for the X50 Ultra and 30,000 Pa for the Matrix10 Ultra and Aqua10 Ultra Roller.
Battery capacity is 5,200 mAh for the L40 Ultra and 6,400 mAh for the other three; the X50 Ultra page cites up to 220 min of cleaning and 205 m2 per charge, the L40 Ultra page up to 194 min.
The reviewed pages publish no dB noise rating, absolute charging time, payload or IP rating; prices are dated US sale observations against regular prices.

body-scope-check.versionScopes: X30 Ultra, L40s Ultra, L50 Ultra and X40 Master are four separate current Dreame cleaning robots. body-scope-check.priceScopes: Prices are published as current shop prices in US dollars: 899.99 for the X30 Ultra, 499.99 for the L40s Ultra, 899.99 for the L50 Ultra and 1,299.99 for the X40 Master. Regular prices of 1,399.99 for the L40s Ultra and L50 Ultra are list prices and are not substituted for the current prices.
body-scope-check.weightScopes: Robot net weights are 9.04 lbs (4.1 kg) for the L40s Ultra, 4.44 kg for the L50 Ultra and 4.07 kg for the X40 Master. The X30 Ultra specification table publishes no robot net weight. Base station and package weights are separate.
body-scope-check.sizeScopes: Robot dimensions are 350 x 350 x 97 mm for the X30 Ultra and L40s Ultra, 348 x 352 x 97 mm for the L50 Ultra and 350 x 350 x 103.8 mm for the X40 Master. Base station dimensions are separate.
body-scope-check.payloadScopes: No reviewed page publishes a payload rating; these are cleaning appliances without a manipulator or load rating.
body-scope-check.enduranceScopes: Battery capacity is 6,400 mAh for the X30 Ultra, L50 Ultra and X40 Master and 5,200 mAh for the L40s Ultra. The L50 Ultra publishes up to 200 min quiet mode and the X40 Master 198 min standard mode; the X30 Ultra specification table lists 180 min while its page text claims up to 260 min, and the L40s Ultra page publishes no runtime in minutes. No page publishes an absolute charging time; the L40s, L50 and X40 pages claim 30 percent faster charging and the X30 page only marks fast charging.
body-scope-check.autonomyScopes: Dreame describes LDS or 3D structured-light navigation, AI obstacle avoidance, mop lifting and extension, hot-water mop washing, auto-empty, auto refilling and draining. These are manufacturer descriptions, not independent safety certification or proof of unsupervised operation.
